text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. At its meeting of May 2, 2017, Etobicoke York Community Council considered Item EY22.24, recommending that a survey of property owners/occupants be conducted on King George's Drive, between Keele Street and Trethewey Drive to determine community support for a proposed traffic calming plan. This report summarizes the result of the traffic calming poll for owners and occupants of King George's Drive, between Keele Street and Trethewey Drive. Polling ballots were mailed to the affected residents on September 14, 2017 and 33% of the residents on King George's Drive, between Keele Street and Trethewey Drive, responded to the polling. As a result, the minimum response rate of 50% plus 1 votes needed to proceed with the installation was not achieved.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on February 21, 2018.
